cover.sub: 5 niche things that will make you annoyingly good at the new eu
cover.title: product liability rules

inner.title: your code is a product
inner.body: the 2024 eu directive counts software as a product, saas and cloud included. it covers products placed on the market after 9 december 2026.
inner.label: saas included

inner.title: skipped patches count
inner.body: the directive says manufacturers are not exempt when a defect comes from missing security updates. an unpatched hole can land on you.
inner.label: patch or pay

inner.title: your model keeps learning
inner.body: defectiveness must weigh a product's ability to keep learning after launch. unexpected behaviour your ai picks up later is still yours.
inner.label: still yours

inner.title: lost data is damage
inner.body: destroyed or corrupted data now counts as damage, if it isn't used for professional purposes. consumer apps that lose user files are exposed.
inner.label: consumer data

inner.title: no cap, long clock
inner.body: national law can't cap liability with a financial ceiling. claims can reach back 10 years from launch, 25 for slow-onset injuries.
inner.label: 10 years

closer.HEADLINE:
it's not a legal memo.
it's your patch log
